name: Meta El Paso data center campus
summary: AI-oriented Meta campus on roughly 1,000 acres in northeast El Paso, Texas, off Stan Roberts Sr. Avenue near US 54. Announced in October 2025 as a USD 1.5 billion project able to scale to 1 GW, it rose to USD 10 billion or more of Meta investment in 2026. In July 2026 Meta placed it in a joint venture 80% owned by BlackRock-managed funds, with a total development cost of about USD 14 billion and capacity due to start coming online in 2028. El Paso Electric has proposed a 366 MW modular gas plant beside the campus; in September 2026 state judges recommended approving it only if ratepayers do not bear its costs.

location.note: Sources place the campus in northeast El Paso off Stan Roberts Sr. Avenue and US 54. Coordinates are a Nominatim point on Stan Roberts Sr. Avenue near that junction, not the parcel centroid.

notes: Meta's joint venture release (s5) displays both 27 and 28 July 2026, so only the month is recorded. Meta's fact sheet PDF (s7) shows no publication date; its embedded file creation date is 2026-09-01.

power_sources.description: Meta says it planned its energy needs with El Paso Electric and pays the full cost of the energy and infrastructure needed to serve the data center.

El Paso Electric proposed the 366 MW McCloud plant on about 31 acres next to the campus, made up of 813 modular 450 kW gas generators supplied by Enchanted Rock; it would serve only Meta for its first five years. Reported cost estimates differ (USD 473 million in January 2026, USD 499 million in September 2026), and a state utility commission vote was still pending in late September 2026.
